title: After Save the Inventory row shows the new description or number without a reload
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Data: QAPL-B1 (stocked at both locations; note {desc}); QAPL-C1 (has a core; note {c-desc}; read the core's part id from the DevTools responses while opening it). DevTools Network tab open with Preserve log on.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory > sort by Part Number; note QAPL-B1's row position and the scroll position.
  2. Open QAPL-B1 > Description "{desc} UPD" > Save.
  3. Open QAPL-B1 > Part Number "QAPL-B1A" > Save.
  4. Switch the location to Staging Lethbridge > Inventory > search "QAPL-B1A".
  5. Back at Staging Heavy Duty: open QAPL-C1 > Description "{c-desc} UPD" > Save; then replay GET /api/inventory/parts/{corePartId}.
  6. Restore: QAPL-B1A > Part Number "QAPL-B1" and Description {desc} > Save; QAPL-C1 > Description {c-desc} > Save.
custom_expected:
1. Rows sorted by Part Number; position noted.
  2. The dialog closes and the row behind it shows "{desc} UPD" in place: no page reload (no new document request in Network), the row keeps its position and the list keeps its sort and scroll.
  3. The row shows QAPL-B1A in place, without a reload, in the same sort order.
  4. The Lethbridge row shows QAPL-B1A and "{desc} UPD".
  5. The QAPL-C1 row shows "{c-desc} UPD" without a reload; the core's name reads "Core for {c-desc} UPD".
  6. Both rows update in place to their original values.
